written.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with native audio
written.summary: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4, an interactive world model that generates photorealistic environments and native audio in real time. The model supports simulations up to two minutes long and allows users to modify scenes using text prompts.

written.headline: OpenAI details Codex sandbox security and execution controls
written.summary: OpenAI published details on how Codex runs commands on user machines while enforcing user-controlled filesystem and network limits across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
